subject: Fix compile overflow warnings (#2963)
reason: The only change adds a defensive guard (`sdslen(parts[0]) < 2`) in evalExtractShebangFlags to silence a compiler integer-underflow warning on `sdslen(parts[0]) - 2`. The function body only runs when the script starts with the literal `#!`, and the first token from sdssplitargs always begins with those two ordinary characters, so parts[0] is always at least 2 bytes. The new branch is unreachable and the subtraction never underflowed; EVAL/FUNCTION produce identical engines, flags, and errors on both builds. This is a compile-warning fix with no reachable behavior change, so no scenario can dist
